# 2 Samuel Chapter 17 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 187r–188r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/2SA_017_page_001.jpg, 2SA_017_page_002.jpg, 2SA_017_page_003.jpg

---

**17:1** And-said Achitophel to Avshalom, "Let-me-choose, please, twelve thousand men, and-I-will-arise and-pursue after David tonight.

**17:2** And-I-will-come upon-him, and-he [is]-weary and-slack of-hands [repheh yadayim], and-I-will-terrify-him, and-all the-people who [are] with-him will-flee, and-I-will-strike the-king alone [levaddo].

**17:3** And-I-will-return all the-people to-you; as-the-returning of-the-whole [is] the-man whom you seek — all the-people will-be [at]-peace."

**17:4** And-the-word was-right in-[the]-eyes of-Avshalom and-in-[the]-eyes of-all [the]-elders of-Yisra'el.

**17:5** And-said Avshalom, "Call, please, also Chushai the-Arki, and-let-us-hear what also [is] in-his-mouth."

**17:6** And-came Chushai to Avshalom, and-spoke Avshalom to-him, saying, "According-to-this word Achitophel has-spoken. Shall-we-do his-word? If not, you speak."

**17:7** And-said Chushai to Avshalom, "Not good [is] the-counsel that Achitophel has-counseled this time.

**17:8** And-said Chushai, "You know your-father and-his-men, that mighty-ones [gibborim] [are]-they, and-bitter of-soul [marey nephesh] [are]-they, as-a-bear bereaved-of-cubs in-the-field. And-your-father [is] a-man of-war, and-he-will-not lodge with the-people.

**17:9** Behold, now he [is]-hidden in-one of-the-pits [pachot] or in-one of-the-places. And-it-will-be when-fall [some]-of-them at-the-beginning, and-the-hearer will-hear and-say, 'There-was a-slaughter among the-people who [are] after Avshalom.'

**17:10** And-also he, [the]-son of-valor [ben chayil], whose heart [is] as-the-heart of-the-lion [aryeh] — melting he-will-melt [himmes yimmas]. For all Yisra'el knows that a-mighty-one [gibbor] [is] your-father, and-sons of-valor [are] those who [are] with-him.

**17:11** For I counsel: let-be-gathered, gathering [he'asef ye'asef], to-you all Yisra'el, from-Dan and-unto Be'er-Sheva, as-the-sand that [is] upon the-sea for-multitude, and-your-face [panim] going in-the-midst [of them].

**17:12** And-we-will-come to-him in-one of-the-places where he is-found there, and-we will-fall [venachnu] upon-him as-falls the-dew upon the-ground, and-not will-be-left of-him and-of-all the-men who [are] with-him also one.

**17:13** And-if to a-city he-gathers-himself, then-will-carry all Yisra'el to that city ropes [chavalim], and-we-will-drag it unto the-wadi [nachal], until not is-found there even a-pebble [tsror]."

**17:14** And-said Avshalom and-all [the]-men of-Yisra'el, "Good [is] the-counsel of-Chushai the-Arki more-than the-counsel of-Achitophel." And-YHWH had-ordained to-defeat [lehapher] the-counsel of-Achitophel the-good, in-order-that YHWH might-bring [lehavi'] the-evil [ha-ra'ah] upon Avshalom.

**17:15** And-said Chushai to Tsadoq and-to Evyatar the-priests, "Thus and-thus Achitophel counseled Avshalom and-the-elders of-Yisra'el, and-thus and-thus I counseled.

**17:16** Now send quickly and-tell David, saying, 'Do-not lodge tonight in-[the]-plains [aravot] of-the-wilderness, and-also crossing cross-over [avor ta'avor], lest be-swallowed-up [yevulla'] the-king and-all the-people who [are] with-him.'"

**17:17** And-Yehonatan and-Achimaats were-standing at-Ein-Rogel, and-the-maidservant went and-told them, and-they went and-told the-king David, for they-could not be-seen to-come to the-city.

**17:18** And-saw them a-youth and-told Avshalom. And-went the-two-of-them quickly and-came to [the]-house of-a-man in-Bachurim, and-he-had a-well in-his-courtyard, and-they-went-down there.

**17:19** And-took the-woman and-spread the-covering [ha-masakh] over [the]-face of-the-well and-spread upon-it the-crushed-grain [ha-riphot], and-the-thing was-not known.

**17:20** And-came [the]-servants of-Avshalom to the-woman [to]-the-house, and-said, "Where [are] Achimaats and-Yehonatan?" And-said to-them the-woman, "They-crossed the-brook [mikhal] of-water." And-they-searched and-did-not find, and-returned to-Yerushalayim.

**17:21** And-it-was after they-had-gone, and-they-came-up from the-well, and-they-went and-told the-king David. And-they-said to David, "Arise and-cross quickly the-water, for thus Achitophel has-counseled against-you."

**17:22** And-arose David and-all the-people who [were] with-him, and-they-crossed the-Yarden. By [the]-light of-the-morning, not was-lacking [even] one who had-not crossed the-Yarden.

**17:23** And-Achitophel saw that his-counsel was-not done, and-he-saddled the-donkey and-arose and-went to his-house, to his-city, and-he-commanded [vayetsav] to his-house, and-he-strangled-himself [vayyechanaq], and-he-died, and-he-was-buried in-[the]-tomb of-his-father.

**17:24** And-David came to-Machanayim. And-Avshalom crossed the-Yarden, he and-all [the]-men of-Yisra'el with-him.

**17:25** And-Amasa Avshalom set in-place-of Yo'av over the-army. And-Amasa [was the]-son of-a-man and-his-name [was] Yitra the-Yisre'eli, who went-in to Avigal [Abigail] daughter of-Nachash, sister of-Tseruyah, mother of-Yo'av.

**17:26** And-encamped Yisra'el and-Avshalom [in the]-land of-Gil'ad.

**17:27** And-it-was when-David came to-Machanayim, and-Shovi son of-Nachash from-Rabbah of-[the]-sons of-Ammon, and-Makhir son of-Ammi'el from-Lo-Devar, and-Barzillai the-Gil'adi from-Roglim —

**17:28** beds [mishkav] and-basins [sappot] and-vessels of-a-potter [yotser], and-wheat and-barley and-flour [qemach] and-parched-grain [qali] and-beans [pol] and-lentils [adashim] and-parched [things],

**17:29** and-honey and-curds [chem'ah] and-flock [tso'n] and-cheeses of-[the]-herd [shepot baqar] they-brought-near to-David and-to-the-people who [were] with-him to-eat. For they-said, "The-people [are]-hungry and-weary and-thirsty in-the-wilderness."

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.3 — "as the returning of the whole":** The Hebrew *keshuv ha-kol* is obscure. Ahithophel appears to compare the ease of returning the entire nation to David's surrender — "when the whole returns, it is [merely] one man you seek." The MT is difficult; some emend following LXX.

**v.10 — himmes yimmas:** Infinitive absolute construction (*melting he will melt*), expressing the totality of the psychological collapse even of the bravest warrior when hearing of defeat.

**v.13 — chavalim:** "Ropes" — Hushai's vivid hyperbole imagines the entire nation dragging a fortified city into the wadi with ropes, a rhetorically brilliant but militarily impractical image designed to dazzle Absalom.

**v.14 — lehapher:** The verb הפר means "to break, frustrate, annul." The narrator breaks the fourth wall to reveal YHWH's hand behind the political maneuvering — the counsel of Ahithophel was objectively superior, but YHWH ordained its defeat.

**v.20 — mikhal ha-mayim:** A rare word; *mikhal* appears only here. It may mean "brook" or "channel." Some read it as a proper noun.

**v.23 — vayyechanaq:** The verb חנק means "to strangle/hang." Ahithophel's death is narrated with four consecutive wayyiqtol verbs — *he saddled, he arose, he went, he commanded, he strangled himself, he died, he was buried* — a stately, deliberate sequence emphasizing the methodical nature of his suicide.

**v.25 — Yitra the Yisre'eli:** The parallel in 1 Chronicles 2:17 reads "Yithra the Yishme'eli" (Ishmaelite). The LC here reads ישראלי (Israelite), which may be a scribal harmonization.

*— EMET*
